checklist.title: Tarrant County Multi-Jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation Action Plan (HazMAP), 2025 (Redacted)

items.question: What kind of document is this? Use the document's own self-description (title page, introduction).
In what year was this document adopted, approved, or published?
Does the document state a later revision or update year? (null if none)
Does the document address extreme heat, extreme cold, both, or neither IN SUBSTANCE (more than a passing mention)?
Which type(s) of agency own or lead the plan? Select several if co-led or led by a multi-agency team.
Name of the lead agency/office as written.
items.value: Tarrant County Emergency Management Coordinator / Hazard Mitigation Planning Team

items.question: If the document rates or ranks hazards (typical in HMPs), what overall rating does extreme heat get? Map the document's scale to high/medium/low.
Same for extreme cold / severe winter weather (use the rating for the hazard that covers extreme cold).
Which hazards that compound heat or cold health effects does the document explicitly connect to heat/cold (e.g. smoke during heat, outages during freezes)?
Does the document reference future warming or climate projections?
Does the document modify heat/cold operations for an infectious disease (e.g. COVID-19 distancing at cooling centers)?
Where does the document's definition of a heat wave / heat emergency / activation condition come from?
Does the document say its activation thresholds or season were chosen using an analysis of LOCAL health or mortality data? (Generic statements that heat is dangerous do not count.)
Which populations does the document identify as being at elevated risk from heat or cold? (Identification only; targeting is coded on commitments.)
Does the document commit to updating the plan, and how often?
Does the document describe or commit to an after-action / post-event / end-of-season review?
Does the review or update process use health or surveillance data (e.g. heat death counts, ED visits)?
